purpose: Define public certification registry projections including certification listing and hash index while keeping registry publication separate from package/source authority.

topics.name: Public Certification Registry
topics.purpose: Define public certification registry projections including certification listing and hash index while keeping registry publication separate from package/source authority.

semantics.list_projection: A public list projection may be published as `/certifications/list.csv`.
semantics.hash_projection: A public integrity index may be published as `/certifications/hash.sha256`.
semantics.source_rule: Registry projection is generated from accepted certification state.
semantics.authority_rule: Registry listing grants no runtime/system authority.
semantics.cache_rule: Mirrors/caches are non-authoritative unless verified against accepted registry evidence.

invariants.rule: Package, artifact, module, certification, license and installed-instance identities remain distinct; hashes prove content integrity only within their declared profile and never grant runtime authority.
License or certification entitlement permits declared product/service use only; it never substitutes for IAM identity, AccessCore authorization, runtime validation or dispatcher gating.

hard_gates.condition: CSV becomes certification source by itself
